aiMetadata.description: Renders a new image (or PDF) from a Bannerbear template by applying layer modifications (text, image URLs, ratings, charts, bar codes, colors). Choose this to programmatically generate branded graphics; requires a valid template UID and modifications matching that template's available layers. Not idempotent — each call submits a new render and produces a new image.
